How to Apply to CityUHK ?
Applicants are required to submit online / Entrance Requirements /
applications to both Research Grants Council
(RGC) and CityUHK. Applicants seeking admission to PhD studies at
CityUHK should satisfy the following minimum
entrance requirements:
STEP 01 Hold a higher degree by research (or
equivalent qualification) from a recognised
RGC’s Application Deadline: university; or
1 December 2026 Hold a Master's degree (or equivalent
qualification) from a recognised university; or
(by 12:00 HKT)
Hold a Bachelor's degree with first class
Obtain an RGC reference
